name: Nanny Button-Cap

attributes.attribute: good fairy in rhymes and stories

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nanny Button-Cap is a sprite from British folklore. This small fairy lives in Yorkshire. She appears in certain verses and tales as a good and helpful being. Her nature is close to that of a brownie.

okr.objective: Nanny Button-Cap is a helpful fairy sprite from Yorkshire folklore.
key_results: Nanny Button-Cap is a British folkloric figure.
She is a small sprite known in Yorkshire.
She appears in some rhymes and stories as a good fairy.
Her nature resembles that of a brownie.
